status: Exploratory raster sketches, not final vector assets

concepts.title: 01 / BEYOND
concepts.brief: Primary logo: a bold near-circular letter O with an intentional generous opening at about two o'clock; one small coral circular dot has just crossed outside that opening. The circle remains visibly an O. Simple even-weight navy ring, dot in coral, no swooshes or arrows. Meaning: a familiar boundary opening to a new interest. This is restrained, ownable, calm and highly recognizable at tiny sizes.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a landscape 4:3 professional logo concept sketch presentation card for the app OtherWise. Product purpose: discover meaningful new topics just beyond your current interests, widening your world; thoughtful, personal, curious, calm. This is an early concept for comparison, not a final brand guide.
Presentation: warm ivory #f0ecdf background, restrained Swiss editorial composition, very generous whitespace. Tiny option number and English concept title at top left, a large standalone original symbol in the main left area, the exact wordmark "OtherWise" beneath it in a refined readable humanist sans serif with correct case, and two small supporting samples on the right: the EXACT SAME symbol in solid monochrome and the EXACT SAME symbol inside a dark navy rounded square app icon. Keep the hero mark large, about 42% of the canvas width. All marks are flat, precise, vector-friendly with crisp edges, no texture, no gradients, no shadows, no mockup photography, no invented paragraph text, no watermarks. Show one single coherent concept per board, not different designs. Practical small icon silhouette, avoid fine intricate detail. Typography should feel subtly customized but be clearly legible. Palette limited to navy #101a29, ivory #f0ecdf, sage #bccfc5 and restrained coral #e4b6b0 as specified. Make it look like an elegant designer's first-round logo sheet.
Text (verbatim), only these strings: "01 / BEYOND" and "OtherWise".

concepts.title: 02 / PERSPECTIVE
concepts.brief: Primary logo: two softly squared portal outlines, offset horizontally and vertically, sharing a cleverly resolved negative-space window at their overlap. One navy, one muted sage. Construct an elegant compact optical symbol from just those two sturdy frames; meaning a shift in perspective and a window into another world. Avoid resembling a chain-link, camera, infinity sign or glasses.

concepts.title: 03 / OW
concepts.brief: Primary logo: an original bold single continuous geometric ribbon monogram integrating a clear rounded O on the left and a folded W on the right into one compact glyph. Predominantly navy, optional small sage terminal. The letterforms should be understandable, NOT arbitrary ribbon loops, NOT an infinity mark. Strong app-icon silhouette with broad strokes, friendly softly rounded corners, innovative typographic construction.

concepts.title: 04 / ORBIT
concepts.brief: Primary logo: a compact abstract interest-galaxy emblem using one thick open oval orbital arc, two circular interest nodes of unequal sizes and a small displaced third coral node. The nodes and orbit form a balanced distinctive geometric silhouette with a gentle sense of discovery. Predominantly navy, coral on only the outer node. NOT a Saturn planet, NOT a atom symbol, no four-point AI sparkle, no tiny constellation web. Meaning connections to an adjacent interest.

concepts.title: 05 / UNFOLD
concepts.brief: Primary logo: three broad folded leaf/page shapes opening outward from a shared lower pivot, forming a simple upward and rightward unfurling symbol. Clever negative-space center, asymmetry, one navy page and one sage page, and an ivory negative-space separation. It should read as knowledge opening into possibilities with a hint of a wing, NOT literal detailed book drawing, NOT a butterfly mascot, NOT a graduation or education stock logo. Compact contemporary flat emblem.

concepts.title: 06 / COMPASS
concepts.brief: Primary logo: a soft circular navy compass frame with a deliberate open arc and a single broad asymmetric sage directional wedge aimed through the opening toward the upper right. An understated coral point at the tip. No cardinal letters, no four-point sparkle, no navigation arrow cliché, no map pin. Invent a warm exploratory geometric mark, with the directional shape integrated beautifully into the negative space of the frame. More human and contemplative than a GPS icon.
